scope: Curated Voodoo compatibility reference, not full upstream documentation

documents.terms: metadata header name namespace version match include exclude noframes run-at grant connect require resource
documents.text: Installable userscripts require // ==UserScript== and // ==/UserScript==. Use @name, @namespace and @version; scope with @match https://example.com/* and optional @exclude-match. @include and @exclude accept globs or slash-delimited regex. Voodoo excludes internal pages and non-HTTP(S) URLs. @noframes limits execution to the main frame. Unknown grants are compatibility errors, not permissions.

documents.terms: storage persistent value getValue setValue deleteValue listValues listener remote
documents.text: Declare each GM helper in @grant. Voodoo supports legacy GM_getValue/GM_setValue/GM_deleteValue/GM_listValues and asynchronous GM.getValue/setValue/deleteValue/listValues. Values are JSON-compatible, private per script, shared across tabs/sites and persisted natively. Legacy reads use a synchronized instance snapshot; await GM.setValue for acknowledged durability. Undefined values are not supported: use deleteValue. Change listeners receive (key, oldValue, newValue, remote); remote is true for another script instance. Remove listeners when no longer needed.

documents.terms: xhr xmlhttpRequest xmlHttpRequest fetch cors connect headers request response abort timeout
documents.text: Native cross-origin HTTP requires @grant GM_xmlhttpRequest or GM.xmlHttpRequest and explicit @connect example.org or self. Voodoo permits HTTPS only, checks every redirect and never forwards WebView cookies or provider credentials. Domain rules include subdomains, with boundary checks. Supported response types: text/json/blob/arraybuffer/document, completion/error/timeout/abort callbacks; modern returns a Promise with abort(). No synchronous HTTP, cookie control, upload/stream progress or extension request interception. Native request/response size limits apply. Page fetch still follows normal website CORS.

documents.terms: document-start document-end document-idle lifecycle timing spa navigation csp isolated unsafeWindow
documents.text: Voodoo injects literal source through AndroidX isolated execution worlds; it does not disable CSP or evaluate source strings in website contexts. Each script has its own JS globals but shares the DOM. unsafeWindow and direct access to page JS globals are unsupported. document-start is earliest injection, but the storage handshake adds asynchronous latency. document-end follows DOMContentLoaded; document-idle queues another task; document-body waits for the body. SPA URL changes do not rerun an already-started script; observe DOM updates or listen for voodoo:urlchange. The event carries url/previous. Reinitialize idempotently. Android may suspend background pages.

documents.terms: selector querySelector querySelectorAll element mutation observer repair dom button click
documents.text: querySelector may return null. Prefer stable IDs, data attributes and aria labels over generated class names. Validate a selector against real DOM observations; do not invent selectors from logs alone. MutationObserver can detect delayed controls; observe the smallest stable parent, debounce changes, and disconnect on teardown. Avoid unbounded setInterval polling. Match element types before editing. Framework inputs may need native property setters plus bubbling input/change events. Synthetic events may not satisfy trusted-user-gesture checks.

documents.terms: event listener click input change debounce preventDefault stopPropagation cleanup
documents.text: Use addEventListener, store callback references, and remove them during cleanup. Event delegation can handle dynamically inserted nodes; use closest() and ensure the target belongs to the expected container. A listener with once:true removes itself after firing. Prevent duplicate installation with an instance guard. Avoid overriding onload or other handlers owned by the page. Do not automatically submit purchases, destructive changes or credential forms.

documents.terms: javascript syntax promise async await try catch scope const let undefined null error stack
documents.text: Use const/let and explicit scope. Await Promise-returning GM methods inside async functions; catch errors and report useful context. Legacy GM methods are not always Promise-returning. Optional chaining prevents null dereference but can hide a missing selector; report the missing element explicitly. Compare values with ===. JSON storage cannot represent functions, DOM nodes, cycles or undefined. Avoid eval and new Function in userscripts. A syntax check does not establish semantic correctness or safety.

documents.terms: require resource library dependency getResourceText getResourceURL addStyle css
documents.text: @require and @resource are downloaded only after explicit execution approval, cached with SHA-256, and included in source syntax validation. @require runs before script source, in declaration order. @resource name URL can be retrieved via GM_getResourceText or GM_getResourceURL with grants. A data URL may still be blocked by a website CSP for a particular DOM usage. Native injection does not grant a CSP bypass for script-created style or script elements. Use pinned dependency URLs; Voodoo supports sha256 fragments and rejects other supplied integrity algorithms.

documents.terms: debug error logs failed permission denied incompatible patch diff repair
documents.text: Use actual script source, declared metadata and runtime logs to diagnose. Distinguish parse errors, missing grants, excluded URL, unsupported WebView isolation, CSP resource rejection, stale selectors and suspended background tabs. Suggest a minimal patch and state assumptions. Never claim a fix was device-tested without evidence. Generated code must be syntax-checked and reviewed as a source diff before saving. Never install or execute a patch automatically. Cloud escalation requires explicit opt-in before sharing script source, page contents or diagnostics.
